thread:
maria: Following up on last week's authz postmortem. We've seen a recurrence of token-validation failures in Dedicated pools when cache invalidation races with rotation. This shows up as 401s for ~30s during rotations. Need clear owners, timelines, and audit/logging fixes.

kevin: saw same on staging this morning. I have a small repro. Looks like KV cache misses + delayed revocation push. Putting logs in the thread.

kevin: ```
2026-03-22T09:12:01Z auth-service token=abc123 event=validate status=fail reason=cache-miss
2026-03-22T09:12:02Z auth-service token=abc123 event=rotate status=success
```

amina: thanks. can you paste the repro steps? want to triage impact (hosted vs dedicated).

kevin: repro: spin up dedicated pool, issue token, trigger rotation via admin API: `curl -XPOST /admin/rotate?pool=d1`. During rotation, validation requests to previously pinning nodes sometimes fail. I think it's a routing/caching window.

oliver: adding SRE to investigate fallback and retry behavior. @sre-oncall can you confirm if we observed similar patterns in last incident's metrics?

sre-oncall: we've got a spike in 5xx/401 at rotation times in both prod and staging. Dashboard: /dashboards/auth/rotations. Suspect gap in audit/logging that makes timeline analysis hard — token revocations not consistently logged with node id.

devops-bot: Incident detector: rotation-induced 401 spike (count=78) detected 2026-03-22T09:12Z. Linked postmortem: https://intranet.redwood/pm/rotations-2026-03

maria: OK action plan proposal:
- A1: Instrument revocation logs with node_id + token_hash (owner: amina, due: 2026-04-02)
- A2: Add stronger retry on validation path for 10s with jitter (owner: kevin, due: 2026-03-30)
- A3: Update rotation runbook to include a pre-warm of cache and staged revocation (owner: oliver, due: 2026-04-06)
- A4: Short-term mitigation: schedule rotations to low traffic windows and add alerting rule for rotation-401 spike (owner: james, due: 2026-03-25)
- A5: Post-implementation audit query and weekly check for 4 weeks (owner: devex, due: 2026-04-13)

james: I can do A4. Will add the alert and schedule next rotation slot. @maria can you approve the low-traffic window?

maria: approved. prefer 02:00-04:00 PT for now.

amina: I'll start on the logging changes. quick question — do we want token_hash to be hashed with a pepper? privacy concerns.

maria: yes, use HMAC with team KMS key, don't log raw tokens.

kevin: working on retry logic PR, will include unit tests and loadbench. PR link when ready.

oliver: runbook updates — I'll add checklist and a playbook for rollback. will also add the audit query snippet.

maria: good. please post PRs here and tag when merged. We'll sync at next incident follow-up on 2026-04-07. If any blockers, escalate to product-security.

sre-oncall: noted. scheduling a short post-merge smoke-run to verify no regression.

devex: we'll add a per-route token-migration test to the CI to catch future regressions.

james: created Alert: `auth.rotation.401_spike` -> threshold 25/min. dashboard link posted.

kevin: repro and PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/412

amina: logging PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/413

maria: thanks all. I'll consolidate into the remediation tracker and assign tickets in JIRA. If anyone cannot meet their due date, ping here and we'll reassign.

oliver: noted. thanks.

sre-oncall: closing the loop — will run eval for next 3 rotations and report anomalies.

maria: end of thread summary pinned in JIRA and linked in the postmortem.
